checks.name: all-outline-vertices-project-from-plane
checks.detail: Every footprint vertex has z=0 and projects to the current spec; footprint is not a spatial plane boundary.

checks.name: entire-infinite-line-belongs-to-plane
checks.detail: n.p0=0 and n.d=0, hence n.(p0+t*d)=0 for every real t. Finite solid depiction is only a viewport.

limitation: Scratch affine/source-incidence checks supplement native 2D assertions; they are author evidence, not independent approval or a new renderer.
